description: Menswear taxonomy for rendering. Axes are independent; 'garments' lists plausible values per axis; 'rules' rejects implausible permutations. See menswear-reference.md for visual descriptions.

henley.signature: Collarless neck with a short 2–5 button placket.

polo.signature: Knit body, soft knit collar, short button placket, ribbed sleeve bands.

rugby_shirt.signature: Heavy jersey, contrast white woven collar, rubber buttons, bold hoops.

dress_shirt.signature: Crisp fine fabric, sharp collar with stays, tucked.

ocbd.signature: Oxford cloth + button-down collar with soft collar roll.

flannel_shirt.signature: Brushed fuzzy matte fabric; flannel is the fabric, plaid is optional.

western_shirt.signature: Pointed yokes, pearl snaps, smile pockets, 3-snap cuffs.

camp_collar_shirt.signature: Flat one-piece collar without stand, straight hem, boxy.

guayabera.signature: Four patch pockets and vertical pleat rows front and back.

overshirt.signature: Heavier shirt-jacket worn as a layer.

tuxedo_shirt.signature: Pleated or piqué bib, studs, French cuffs.

hoodie.signature: Hood with drawcords; kangaroo pocket on pullovers.

pullover_sweater.signature: Knit pullover; gauge + fiber decide the look.

cardigan.signature: Knit that opens down the front.

varsity_jacket.signature: Melton body, leather sleeves, chenille letters

harrington.signature: Short zip jacket, check lining, umbrella yoke

waxed_jacket.signature: Waxed cotton, cord collar, bellows pockets

performance_tee.signature: Smooth synthetic tee, mesh panels, flatlock seams.

running_long_sleeve.signature: Long-sleeve running top with thumbholes and reflective trims.

athletic_half_zip.signature: Stand collar with short zip and chin guard.

track_jacket.signature: Full zip, stand collar, side stripes or color-blocked panels.

windbreaker.signature: Light packable nylon jacket, elastic cuffs.

softshell_jacket.signature: Fitted stretch jacket, chest zip pocket.

fleece_pullover.signature: Fleece with stand collar and contrast nylon pocket.

soccer_jersey.signature: Sublimated pattern, crest on chest, number on back.

hockey_jersey.signature: Very loose, laced V-neck, striped arms and hem.

baseball_jersey.signature: Button front with piping, script across chest.

cycling_jersey.signature: Slim zip jersey with three rear pockets.

two_in_one_shorts.signature: Short outer over a longer visible compression liner.

training_shorts.signature: Mid inseam, side and zip pockets.

track_pants.signature: Side stripes, ankle zips, elastic waist.

tech_pants.signature: Slim tapered stretch woven, zip pockets.

pajama_set_woven.signature: Notched-lapel button top with piping, matching drawstring trousers.

pajama_set_knit.signature: Knit top with matching pants or shorts.

lounge_pants.signature: Relaxed straight leg, elastic waist; often plaid flannel.

lounge_knit_set.signature: Relaxed crew sweater with matching knit jogger.

lounge_sweatsuit.signature: Matching sweatshirt or hoodie and sweatpants.

robe.signature: Wrap front with belt, shawl collar, knee to ankle length.

kimono_robe.signature: Straight collar band down the front, wide sleeves, sash.

smoking_jacket.signature: Short velvet jacket with quilted or satin shawl collar.

patent_oxford.signature: Mirror-gloss black, closed lacing; black tie

wholecut.signature: One piece of leather, no seams but the heel

brogue.signature: Punched edges; semi (cap + medallion) or full wingtip

derby.signature: Open lacing, plain or cap toe

monk_strap.signature: One or two buckled straps instead of laces

penny_loafer.signature: Strap with a slot across the vamp

driving_moc.signature: Soft slip-on with rubber nubs on sole and heel

desert_boot.signature: Chukka with crepe sole, unlined suede

service_boot.signature: 6 in, plain or cap toe, welted

moc_toe_boot.signature: 6 in moc toe, white wedge sole, oiled leather

hiking_boot.signature: Mid height, padded collar, speed hooks, lug sole

duck_boot.signature: Rubber lower, leather or nylon upper, chain tread

western_boot.signature: Pointed or square toe, Cuban heel, stitched shaft

canvas_low_top.signature: Canvas, vulcanized sole with foxing stripe, toe cap

canvas_high_top.signature: Canvas high-top, vulcanized sole, ankle patch

retro_court_shoe.signature: Leather, perforated toe, side stripes, cupsole

skate_shoe.signature: Suede or canvas, padded tongue and collar

retro_runner.signature: Suede and nylon panels, EVA wedge midsole

running_shoe.signature: Knit mesh upper, thick sculpted foam midsole

trail_runner.signature: Lug outsole, toe bumper, toggle laces

trainer.signature: Flat stable sole, mesh with overlays

chunky_sneaker.signature: Very thick layered midsole, many overlays

boat_shoe.signature: Moccasin apron, rawhide laces around the collar, siped sole

sandal.signature: Fisherman, two-strap cork footbed, sport or huarache

moccasin_slipper.signature: Soft suede, apron toe, shearling lining

velvet_slipper.signature: Velvet upper, quilted lining, embroidered vamp

felt_clog.signature: Boiled wool upper, cork or rubber sole

cap.signature: Baseball, dad, five-panel or trucker cap

brimmed_hat.signature: Fedora, trilby, panama, boater, bucket, flat cap

tie.signature: Silk, knit, wool, grenadine or bow tie

pocket_square.signature: Silk, linen or cotton; flat, point, puff or crown fold

scarf.signature: Knit, woven wool, cashmere, silk, bandana

bag.signature: Tote, backpack, messenger, briefcase, duffel, sling

rules.then: fabric must come from knit_structure, not woven_structure
fabric must come from woven_structure
weave=oxford AND collar=button_down
'flannel' is only a woven_structure/finish; never a pattern value
hem in [straight, straight_with_vents]; usually untucked
collar not in [button_down, camp, band, western]
garment in [western_shirt, work_shirt, overshirt]
collar=none
knit gauge must fall within fiber_gauge_plausible[fiber]
specify corduroy_wales_per_inch; shirts usually needlecord/standard
weave not in [flannel, corduroy, canvas, denim, madras, seersucker]
pattern_scale and pattern_orientation required
pattern_orientation=horizontal
placket=none
compression and performance garments are never linen, wool flannel, tweed, corduroy or raw denim
collar=stand AND placket=zip_full
closes with a sash belt; no zip or full button front
hem_finish=ribbed_cuff
neon colors, sublimated all-over prints and reflective trims only on synthetic fabrics
suede chukkas, desert boots, some Chelseas; never patent or business Oxfords
dress shoes and dress boots only
boots only
black tie only
closed_oxford: eyelet tabs under the vamp; open_derby: eyelet tabs on top of the vamp
no belt loops, no belt
rise in [mid, high] AND leg in [straight, tapered, wide, relaxed]
leg in [straight, tapered, wide]; not on joggers
no belt
bottoms.denim_washes and denim_fades apply to denim (and some canvas/duck) only
base has collar in [point, semi_spread, spread, cutaway, button_down, hidden_button_down, club, tab, pin, wing]
belt leather color and finish match the shoes
at most one color from colors.families.bright per outfit outside athletic
two patterns need different scale or type plus a shared color; never same type and similar scale adjacent
draw the base collar outside the mid neckline
no collared shirt beneath

performance_jersey.look: smooth, uniform, faint even sheen, thin, clings, small sharp creases

birdseye_mesh.look: small holes in a regular pattern, often as side or back panels

double_knit_poly.look: thick, smooth both sides, holds shape, soft sheen; track suits

tricot.look: smooth shiny face, slight crinkle; retro track tops

grid_fleece.look: smooth face, raised grid of squares on the back

compression_knit.look: skin-tight, slight sheen, no folds, visible panel seams

four_way_stretch_woven.look: matte to soft sheen, smooth, technical, few wrinkles

nylon_taffeta.look: thin, crinkly, crisp creases, slight sheen

waterproof_shell.look: smooth, slightly stiff, crisp angular folds, taped seams inside

swim_fabric.look: smooth, quick-dry, slight sheen; darker and clinging when wet

visual_signatures.smooth_calf: bright specular highlight on the toe, creases across the vamp
visual_signatures.suede: no highlight, matte nap, color shifts with direction
visual_signatures.white_sneaker_wear: yellowing at sole edge, creases across the toe

fabric_effects.denim: near-navy when raw; fades toward mid and light blue; whiskers, honeycombs, paler seams; white-ish inside
fabric_effects.linen: chalky and slightly lighter; whites look creamy
fabric_effects.brushed: deeper and softer, no highlights, patterns blur
fabric_effects.corduroy_velvet: light crest, dark groove; richer and darker in folds
fabric_effects.suede: shifts with nap direction; brushed areas lighter
fabric_effects.heathered_marled: lighter, softer, flecked version of the base
fabric_effects.garment_pigment_dyed: muted, uneven, darker at seams, lighter at edges
fabric_effects.synthetic_performance: cleaner, brighter, more saturated; neons possible
fabric_effects.leather: smooth has highlights; pull-up lightens where flexed; tan darkens with age
fabric_effects.sun_fade: shoulders, collar and upper back lighter

colors.notes: app_color is a value of COLOR in backend/closet/vocab.py; earth and bright list app colors, so 'bright blue' means royal_blue or cobalt, not navy

layering_rules: each layer fits over the one beneath: thin and fitted inside, thick and roomy outside
a shirt collar sits outside a crewneck or V-neck; nothing collared under a turtleneck
an untucked shirt may show 1-2 in below a sweater; never far below a jacket hem
a hoodie under a jacket puts the hood outside the jacket collar; hoodie under a blazer is streetwear
tucked shirt with belt loops means a belt
dress shirts and long-tail shirts tuck; camp-collar, straight-hem shirts, polos, tees and knitwear usually do not
a turtleneck can replace a shirt and tie under a blazer or overcoat
a sweater vest goes over a shirt, never over a hoodie
base + mid + outer is the useful maximum; a fourth thin layer only in cold weather

temperature_bands_c.outfit: base only; shorts or light trousers; sneakers, loafers, sandals
base; optional light overshirt or unlined jacket
base + light mid or light outer
base + mid + light outer, or base + medium outer
base + mid + warm outer; heavier fabrics
warm base + warm mid + insulated outer; hat, scarf, gloves; boots

outfit.rain: outer must be water-resistant (shell, waxed, trench, mac); avoid suede shoes
outfit.formality_notes: app FORMALITY has no 'lounge'; lounge pieces map to the app's athletic until the app adds it
formality_rules: every piece within one level of the target
shoes and outer layer set the impression most strongly
one dressier piece is fine (blazer over tee and jeans = smart_casual)
dressing down only in shoes, and only in casual and smart_casual
athletic mixes only with casual, never with business
smooth fine fabrics are dressier; rough textured fabrics more casual
color_rules: build on two neutrals plus at most one accent
light top with dark bottom is the default contrast
avoid near-identical but different shades in adjacent pieces
at most one bright color outside sportswear
denim is a neutral blue; double denim needs clearly different washes
brown shoes with everything except black trousers; black shoes with grey, black, navy
belt matches shoes in smart and business outfits
pattern_rules: one pattern per outfit is always safe
two patterns need different scales or types and a shared color
three patterns only in tailoring, three scales, one shared color
never two patterns of the same type and similar scale side by side
textured solids count as half a pattern
loud prints are the focus: everything else solid and neutral
proportion_rules: slim top with slim or straight bottom; roomy top with straight or wide bottom
boxy cropped tops with higher-rise straighter trousers
short jackets end near the waistband
chunky shoes balance wider legs; sleek shoes suit slim legs and short breaks
no break with loafers and sneakers, slight break with dress shoes, stacked jeans with boots
